title: A new form keeps shared meaning
meaning: Changing shared actions is motivated by ending an earlier approach and emotionally answered by connection to a meaning that still matters to both people.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of this Energy Field shows shared actions being reorganised as circumstances change. Death in energy connects motivation with bringing a form to an end when it can no longer continue in the same way. The Hierophant in emotions adds a sense of belonging to a shared meaning or custom. Endings and continuity can coexist in the overall tone: you do something differently together while emotionally recognising the value that made it matter before.

For example, an old photograph album can no longer hold additional pages, so you finish it with a final captioned page. You collect new photographs in another book, changing your working arrangement while keeping the custom of choosing pictures together. **One album is finished, while our custom of preserving shared memories continues.** The warm response comes from a recognisable meaning, although the materials, presentation and practical participation now differ noticeably from before.

A difficulty appears if the sense of continuity is used to deny that an ending has occurred. The new book must then reproduce the old one in every respect, leaving the change merely outward. Alternatively, ending one form is taken to require abandoning every custom. Death as motivation does not demand that the past be devalued. The Hierophant in emotions does not require a preserved tradition to remain identical for both people forever.
